reviewer: UI art-direction and interaction-design reviewer (visual design / UI-UX), round C
regressions: Round B's 24 px targets (6eb3883) overflowed the investor-offer rows at 1920x1080: the progress bar's track was drawn over the task text and Claim hung 7 px out of each row (fixed in a46e834 + 60f6267).
unresolvedRisks: Workbench on desktops 900 px tall or less (1280x800 through 1600x900): the third job (Research) is cut 25 px by its panel, with an overlay scrollbar and no '▾ more' pill.

Map callouts (R&D online, Server room online) stay up after you enter a bay: at 1920 the callout covers the trail's right 74x110 px for up to 10 s; on phones it covers the trail's foot and the fuel line, although the rules say it should wait while the map is hidden.
Toasts on the legacy screen still cover the third column's header (Recursion) and the top of the Auto-Trainer card, the card the screen is built to highlight (1920 and 4K).
On phones, toasts now clear the supply cells but sit over the first station card for 5.5-7.5 s; achievement toasts don't take taps, but they still hide the primary job.
A mail toast can land over the PARADIGM SHIFT banner mid-run (only the summit holds toasts back).
Canvas text: skill-hill labels are cut at the canvas edge ('Pattern Mat', 'Tokenizatio'), the summit pop's left end is cut, and 'slipstream +20.2' overlaps the '↑ 2.6 m' height label.
The early desktop lab is still about 85% empty floor at 1920 (layout reserves homes on purpose: owner's call).

Upright phones: the run view now reserves 64 px for the bar's second row and the meter's second line, so the trail is 448 px at 390x844 (was 512) and 331 at 390x727 (was 395). Act one shows an empty band under the crumbs until Restart appears.
Narrow desktop: a toast placed under the supply cells overlaps the first hardware price pill by about 5 px; at 1280 the clickable mail toast takes that band.
4K was spot-checked only: Playwright's clicks time out under CSS zoom 1.9, so later states weren't reached there.
